purpose: give a person independent of the implementation the evidence needed to accept the remaining security risk of a release
entry_criteria: Security stages in scope (threat model, SAST, DAST, SCA, secrets) have recorded results
Open findings and exceptions are listed with owners
Auditor did not implement the controls being reviewed
procedure: Collect the evidence record of each security stage and check it names a real commit, command and result.
Re-run a sample of the recorded checks independently and compare results.
List every open finding, exception and residual risk with owner and expiry; flag any without one.
Decide per finding: accept, require fix, or require compensating control; state reasoning.
Write the sign-off record: scope, evidence reviewed, sample re-runs, decision, conditions.
Submit to the security-lead for the human decision; do not self-approve.
acceptance_criteria: Every security stage in scope has evidence or an explicit waiver
Sample re-runs agree with recorded results
No critical or high finding is open without a security-lead exception
Decision and conditions are written and dated
validation_method: Security-lead approval of the sign-off record.

validation.command: python3 scripts/check_references.py && python3 scripts/validate.py   # repository integrity before review

validation.check: open each stage evidence record and confirm commit, command, result and that it is not flagged example

failure_modes.detection: Record flagged example or lacks a command and revision
failure_modes.response: Treat as FAIL for that stage; do not sign off

failure_modes.detection: Auditor appears as implementer in the record
failure_modes.response: Reassign review to an independent person

failure_modes.mode: Pressure to ship with open critical findings

worked_example: ILLUSTRATIVE: Evidence is complete except one DAST high finding with a fix merged but not retested. The auditor requires the retest as a condition; sign-off is conditional on that passing before release.
